## Context

Preserve claim certification, third-party symbol grounding, sign-on-PASS, and local-source non-certifiability; reduce each block to its local why. Content consumer: comment-hygiene scan only; no exact-text consumer.

## Plan
Keep the shortest explanation of the scenario, invariant, or fixture boundary; remove chronology and prose already expressed by the test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The cited prose is concise and current.
- [ ] The behavioral oracle and preserve list remain explicit.
- [ ] Behavior-bearing fixture or consumer text is unchanged.

## Verification
Review the diff against the preserve list and run the affected tests.
